# Check overlap between blacklist and human TE reference.

Here we would like to check what is the percentage of the overlap information of our peaks within inside the blacklist of human reference.

1.  The repeat annotation and mappability artifacts are found. (Terry Furey et al.)

2.  From the Boyle-Lab, can download hg19-blacklist.bed.gz, <https://github.com/Boyle-Lab/Blacklist/blob/master/lists/Blacklist_v1/hg19-blacklist.bed.gz>

3.  Paper: The ENCODE Blacklist: Identification of Problematic Regions of the Genome (2019)

4.  bash command

    ``` bash
    # Calculate intersect bed
    bedtools intersect -a hg19_rmsk.bed -b hg19-blacklist.bed -wao > hg19_overlap_blacklist_rmsk.bed

    # calculate the sum length of hg19_rmsk.bed
    awk '{sum += $3 - $2} END {print sum}' hg19_rmsk.bed #1519039925

    # calculate the sum length of hg19-blacklist.bed
    awk '{sum += $3 - $2} END {print sum}' hg19-blacklist.bed #11588272

    # calculate percentage
    overlap=$(awk '{sum += $NF} END {print sum}' hg19_overlap_blacklist_rmsk.bed)
    total=$(awk '{sum += $3 - $2} END {print sum}' hg19_rmsk.bed)
    echo $(echo "$overlap / $total * 100" | bc -l) #.68739213684590943100

    ```

    So the result is that hg19_rmsk has 0.687% overlap with the blacklist region.

5.  additional information, below are the repeats mention in blacklist

    ``` bash
    (CATTC)n
    (GAATG)n
    (GAGTG)n
    ACRO1
    ALR/Alpha
    ```
